scope: Read-only definition recovery; no producer import/run, market-data replay, refit, backtest, service operation or migration.

register_predicates.OL08: flow==fill_linked and observed_next_level and next_lots<10; both onset types retained
register_predicates.OL09: Retain all causal order origins, age bins, prior-onset bins; subsequent fate/replenishment remains separately clocked event history.
register_predicates.EX03: Two source populations, ten response targets (next change plus nine fixed horizons), spread and touch strata.
register_predicates.EX05: Same-order T-to-A identity; four timer delays crossed with four observation horizons, plus separate five-horizon start/end inventory.
register_predicates.missing_contract: Every predicate has unavailable state if any required evidence absent; absence of next level in a complete book is no_next, not next_ge10 or next_lt10.

causal_contract.identity: Preserve session, instrument, source version, group ordinal, first/close cursors, side/order/event ID. Cursor sequence breaks equal-clock ties; no cross-session order identity inference.
causal_contract.availability: Use completed group with recorded receive/known-by clock and actual delivery. Historical receive is not proof of earlier deployment availability.
causal_contract.missing: Missing book, order lineage, group close, tape join, endpoint or clock remains unavailable. An observed empty next level differs from missing book.
causal_contract.retention: All source populations and censored/ended-before-entry/missing observations remain in outer ledger. Source filters are documented, not promoted to outcome-conditioned entry filters.
causal_contract.trade_mapping: Recovered source observations and hypothetical entry quote conventions are not fills. Actual fill/execution mapping remains a separately identified adapter.

OL_onset.predicate: At completed close current side touch size == 1, and either current price != preceding retained close price or unchanged price with prior size > 1.
OL_onset.prior_touch: Previous close on same side: [price_raw,lots,order_count]. Opposite touch is current close.
OL_onset.group_filter_source: S00280 retains only groups with nonempty bid/ask and non-null prices; previous means previous retained group. No initial-row onset. This is not S01763 valid-segment filtering.
OL_onset.unsafe_gap_policy: A source-skipped missing group must not silently establish live adjacency or uninterrupted episode survival; report unavailable continuity until verified.
OL_onset.recorded_t: S00736 requires exact onset transition group/cursor/known_by equality and each linked trade available_ns <= signal known_by_ns, matching group close cursor and transition line. Boolean means observed linked T, not fill-linked reduction.

OL_first_end.event: First strictly later retained group at which touch price differs from onset price or size != 1. Cannot be known before that close.
OL_first_end.labels: Same price => SIZE_RECOVERED_AT_SAME_PRICE (source tests !=1, not >1); B lower/A higher => RETREATED; other changed price => IMPROVED; no observed end => CENSORED (S00280) or WINDOW_CENSORED (S01693).
OL_first_end.source_entry: First completed quote >= onset known_by/receive + 1,000,000ns; S01693 also searches strictly after onset index. Not an actual order fill.
OL_first_end.end_vs_entry: Observed end cursor/group <= observed entry cursor/group => BY_ENTRY including equality, else AFTER_ENTRY. S00736 explicitly emits NO_OBSERVED_END / NO_OBSERVED_ENTRY.
OL_first_end.source_bug_to_preserve_not_infer: S00280 emits AFTER_ENTRY if end exists but no entry exists. Store that source label separately; normalized actionable status is NO_OBSERVED_ENTRY, never assume a fill.
OL_first_end.extra_original_wrapper: S01693 horizons [1,5,30] seconds from hypothetical entry, first quote >= entry+h; entry/exit censoring explicit. Distinct source variant from first-end target; not a replacement.

OL_history.population: STANDING_BEST_SHRANK only; preserve onset line and exact source coordinates.
OL_history.window: Exactly three immediately preceding book closes, excludes onset close.
OL_history.validation: For each prior row signal.group-prior.group == signal_index-prior_index, prior.cursor < signal.cursor, prior.known_by_ns <= signal.known_by_ns. Failure is invalid evidence, not a state label.
ordered_classification: any prior touch price != onset new_best_raw: PRIOR_BEST_PRICE_CHANGED
OL_history.boundary: FALLING/BUILDING are weak monotonicity with at least one strict change because FLAT checked first; onset size is not included.

OL_tape_and_identity.flow: Capture mutations only within onset first_cursor through close_cursor. Count reductions at original price: nonzero linked_display_reduction => linked reduction; otherwise unlinked; reprices out are separate. fill_linked if linked count>0 else unlinked_reduction if unlinked count>0 else no_reduction.
OL_tape_and_identity.fill_link: Book F accumulates same order/current price pending fills; C/M at same price or remove links min(reduction,pending). Clear pending at F_LAST. T is not F.
OL_tape_and_identity.next_level: Sort nonempty same-side prices descending B / ascending A at onset close. Second price and sum displayed lots. Observed absent => no_next; size<10 => next_lt10; >=10 => next_ge10.
OL_tape_and_identity.prior_orders: Previous touch order_count <=2 => prior_orders_le2, else prior_orders_gt2; missing prior count unavailable.
OL_tape_and_identity.order_origin: Require exactly one touch order. Start older_resting. Process onset captured mutations in cursor order for that ID with after at side/onset price: A => fresh_add; M from another price => repriced_in; same-price M reducing size => size_cut_in_place; C => partial_cancel_in_place. Last qualifying assignment wins, not simply last arbitrary mutation.
OL_tape_and_identity.age: First observed A timestamp for ID through reset; age_ms=round((onset close receive-first A receive)/1e6,3). Missing first A => none. Bins: <10 under_10ms; <1000 10ms_to_1s; <60000 1s_to_60s; else over_60s. Boundaries use rounded age.
OL_tape_and_identity.prior_onsets: Read counter before incrementing for current onset; bins min(counter,3). Original first_seen and open_fates clear on R but onsets_by_order does NOT clear on R: retain source semantics and separate reset-aware deployment choice.
OL_tape_and_identity.later_fate: First post-onset-close C/M/F for ID only. M_away if price differs; M_size_up if same price and size>before size; otherwise M_same_price. Future fate and repeat-ID share over whole population cannot gate onset.
OL_tape_and_identity.source_filters: S00279 drops missing tape and CENSORED rows, zip joins by list position; causal integration must verify (session,onset_group,side,onset_cursor), retaining excluded observations separately.

populations.aggression_to_rest: event_id, source=start_group, decision=start_known_by_ns (initial completed group recognition)
populations.family_prebirth: instance, source=saved pre_group, decision=anchor_ns-1; retrospective diagnostic, never a post-recognition trade entry

EX03.endpoint: For fixed target decision+h choose LAST completed group timestamp <= target, including equality (searchsorted right-1). May equal source group and yield valid flat. Target must be <= last retained timestamp; source/end valid and same segment.
EX03.next_change: First strictly later index with different bid_raw+ask_raw along contiguous valid same-segment groups; endpoint receive must be > decision. Invalid row/segment break stops search. No later change => boundary_or_no_later_change, not flat.
EX03.touch: (bid_lots-ask_lots)/(bid_lots+ask_lots). >0 bid_heavy, <0 ask_heavy, exact zero balanced. Original NaN falls through to balanced; preserve source label separately, normalized undefined denominator stays unavailable.
EX03.change: ((endpoint_bid+endpoint_ask)-(source_bid+source_ask))/(2*1e9) price units; in ticks divide the same numerator by 2*1e6. No source directional trade fill is implied.
EX03.valid_segment: S01763 good = OPEN<=receive<CLOSE, both sides exist, 0<bid<ask, and none reset_member/snapshot_member/bad_receive_clock_member. Increment segment on each invalid group. Original October18 OPEN=1697580000*1e9 and CLOSE=1697662800*1e9; other sessions require their own source scope, never reuse these calendar constants.
EX03.guard: A family birth group can be first midpoint change one ns after prebirth cutoff. Outcome retained in diagnostic; cannot become a fill after recognition.

EX05_identity.event: Within a valid completed group, one or more T records with same nonzero order ID and wire side precede positive-size A matching ID/side. Trade price need not equal add price. pending keyed ID, first T side retained, sums T lots/distinct prices; clear pending at group boundary.
EX05_identity.event_id: rest-{add_cursor}-{order_id}; identity is order event, not participant.
EX05_identity.known_by: Initial completed group close timestamp and cursor. An order that clears within this group is retained with size_at_start_close=0 and visible_at_start_close=false.
EX05_identity.F: Only matching tracked side and price increases cumulative fills and pending; F does not itself reduce display.
EX05_identity.C: after=max(0,displayed-size); partial C is not automatic termination. Match min(pending,display reduction), decrement matched pending.
EX05_identity.M: Changed side or price terminates reprice; same-price M sets displayed=size, matches pending reductions, implied_additions += max(0,after-before+pending), then pending=0.
EX05_identity.clear: At after==0: fill_linked_clear if reduction>0 and matched==reduction; mixed_clear if matched>0; else unmatched_clear. Unmatched clear is not proof of voluntary cancellation.
EX05_identity.other_ends: Duplicate A while tracked => duplicate_add_unresolved; R => reset_censored; retained EOF => session_end_censored. Group boundary accumulates unmatched pending and clears pending.
EX05_identity.no_lookahead: Terminal kind and total lifetime/fills are outcomes. Live survival requires observed completed state and complete continuity, not retrospective end_known_by_ns field.

EX05_observation.decision: start_known_by_ns + delay*1e6; quote is LAST completed group <= timer, not next group after timer.
EX05_observation.state: Use only event actions group_known_by_ns<=timer sorted by raw cursor; last provides displayed_after,cumulative_passive_fills. Initial fallback size_at_start_close,fills=0.
EX05_observation.eligible_source: end_known_by_ns > decision strict. Equal end clock means ended already. All decisions retained; source emits outcomes only for eligible decisions.
EX05_observation.eligible_causal: No observed terminating action at completed group <=timer, positive known tracked display at original identity/price, complete source coverage. Unknown lineage/coverage => unavailable. Never consume future end_known_by_ns as timer input.
EX05_observation.features: at_touch = original resting price equals side best on decision quote; fill_fraction=fills_known/initial_display; fill_state=some_passive_fills if fills_known>0 else no_passive_fills_yet. At-touch alone does not establish survival.
EX05_observation.outcomes: Target=decision+h; LAST completed group <=target; target<=last retained time and source/end good and same segment. Direction-oriented midpoint change from decision quote. Missing endpoint=censored_or_boundary, not flat.

EX05_inventory_outcomes.clock: Each anchor has own completed close timestamp. Latest completed quote <= anchor+h; same validity/segment endpoint checks.
EX05_inventory_outcomes.separation: This is a distinct outcome grid from observation [0.1,1,5,20]. End-close outcome never becomes onset input; preserve both grids and original populations.

residual_limits: No actual platform order/fill adapter supplied by these producers.
No production replay was run; synthetic fixtures check clocks and boundaries only.
Original source quirks are explicitly retained; corrected normalized missingness is not claimed as original research behavior.
